name: Sola Energy template

source.readFrom: Extracted from the Desktop design frame.

character: Clean, modern ECO / green-energy template. Near-black ink on white, one bright lime-chartreuse accent with pale-lime and charcoal full-width bands, rounded cards, and soft decorative blobs/line-art. Polished and friendly. Good reference for sustainability, home-services, solar, wellness, or any fresh modern brand.

typography.notes: Single neutral sans (Inter). Headings mix weight/colour — part of the heading is bold ink, part is a lighter grey, for a two-tone title effect ('Transforming Homes, Empowering Futures').

color.notes: Charcoal ink #383838 (not pure black) on white. ONE bright lime accent #ceff41 for CTAs, the highlighted service card, and small icons; a pale-lime #f5fbe7 for section bands and an olive #668411 for deeper accents. A dark charcoal band anchors the final CTA. REUSE the neutral+one-bright-accent structure; swap the lime for the lead's brand colour.

spacing.notes: Roomy sections (~64–80px), rounded cards with 20–24px padding, ~1200px content column.

button.notes: Lime primary CTA; a thin-outline pill for secondary ('Discover your savings potential').

card.shape: White, subtle border, rounded corners; the featured card is filled lime.

components.link: Text link + trailing up-right arrow icon ('Learn More →').

sectionLayouts.note: Real top-to-bottom recipe. Reuse the archetypes; swap in the lead's brand + content.

order.layout: Logo left · nav links in a pill, right.
Full-width rounded image block; overlaid left-aligned heading + subhead + lime CTA; a decorative sunburst/line-art accent in a corner.
Two columns split by a thin divider: left a two-tone big heading + short line; right a longer paragraph + a text-arrow link.
On a pale-lime band: centered heading, 3 rounded cards (middle one filled lime as the highlight): image → title → description, plus a text-arrow link below.
On a lime band: heading + a 2×2 grid of benefit items (icon chip → heading → text) + an outline pill button. Soft circle blobs decorate one side.
Heading, then two quote cards side by side (one filled lime, one grey): quote → avatar → name/location.
Dark charcoal band: heading + subhead + lime CTA, with leaf-shaped image circles on the opposite side.
Logo + social icons, then a multi-column link grid (About / Services / Contact) and copyright.

reusableArchetypes: full-width rounded hero image with overlaid copy + one CTA
two-column intro with a two-tone heading
3 service cards with one filled-accent highlight
craftNotes: One bright accent does all the work; everything else is neutral, so it reads clean not busy.
Full-width pale/bright bands separate sections instead of borders.
Soft circle blobs and light line-art add life without clutter; cards are generously rounded.

referenceImages.reference.png: The full desktop template showing the eco/green system in use.

reuse: Great for sustainability / home-services / wellness / fresh modern brands. Take the neutral + one-bright-accent palette structure, two-tone headings, rounded cards with a single filled-accent highlight, coloured section bands, and the archetypes. Put the lead's brand colour in the lime slot.
